name: Marker chime
description: Local browser chime when an ENTRY or SELL marker first appears on the newest closed candle. Phone pushes are owned by the Apps Script sheet relay (BravoStatusPoller → Telegram); browsers never push, so multiple viewers don't duplicate messages.
_comment: build: false turns the chime off. The Notify toggle (alert-muted) still mutes it per browser. frequency in Hz, duration and maxAgeSeconds in seconds.
